Interface InventoryProvider

All Superinterfaces:
InventoryHandler
All Known Implementing Classes:
ConfigurableInventoryProvider
public interface InventoryProvider extends InventoryHandler
Defines the blueprint for creating and managing inventory GUI screens.

An InventoryProvider is registered with the InventoryManager and is responsible for:

  • Creating new InventoryView instances on demand
  • Rendering and updating the contents of those views
  • Handling inventory events (clicks, open, close) via InventoryHandler

Registration

InventoryProvider provider = new MyCustomProvider("shop");
manager.registerProvider(provider);

Programmatic Implementation

public class ShopProvider implements InventoryProvider {
    @Override
    public @NotNull String getId() { return "shop"; }

    @Override
    public @NotNull InventoryView createView(@NotNull InventoryContext context) {
        Inventory inv = Bukkit.createInventory(null, 27, Component.text("Shop"));
        return new InventoryViewImpl("shop", inv, context, this);
    }

    @Override
    public void update(@NotNull InventoryView view) {
        // Populate the inventory with items
    }

    @Override
    public void onClick(InventoryClickEvent event, InventoryContext context) {
        event.setCancelled(true);
        // Handle click logic
    }
}

  • Method Details

    • getId

      @NotNull @NotNull String getId()
      Returns the unique identifier for this provider.

      This ID is used to register the provider with the InventoryManager and to reference it when opening menus (e.g., "main_menu", "shop").

      Returns:
      the provider ID; never null

    • createView

      @NotNull @NotNull InventoryView createView(@NotNull @NotNull InventoryContext context)
      Creates a new InventoryView for the given context.

      Each call should return a fresh view instance. The view's Bukkit inventory is created here, typically with a title parsed from MiniMessage and a size determined by configuration.

      Parameters:
      context - the inventory context containing player, placeholders, and metadata; must not be null
      Returns:
      a newly created inventory view; never null

    • update

      void update(@NotNull @NotNull InventoryView view)
      Renders or updates the contents of the given view.

      This method is called:

      • Once immediately after the view is created (initial render)
      • Periodically by the global ticker if isAutoRefresh() returns true
      • Manually via InventoryView.refresh()

      Implementations should populate the view's inventory with the appropriate items based on the current context state.

      Parameters:
      view - the inventory view to update; must not be null

    • isAutoRefresh

      default boolean isAutoRefresh()
      Returns whether this provider's views should be automatically refreshed by the InventoryManager's global ticker.

      When enabled, the manager will call update(InventoryView) on all active views from this provider approximately once per second (every 20 ticks). This is useful for dynamic content like timers, live statistics, or animated elements.

      Default implementation returns false.

      Returns:
      true if auto-refresh is enabled; false otherwise
